geography.property_boundary: Two adjacent lots on corner of Southgate Ave + Samantha Ave, Flint MI

green.label: Garage — Floating Third Point
green.role: EDGE — DDR3 NUCs + eero mesh, floating compute outpost
green.network: WiFi bridge via eero → catches Flint/House WiFi
green.connection: eero WiFi bridge to Flint GAIA or ApertureScience → ethernet to NUCs

house_to_garage.path: Wireless — eero catches Flint/House WiFi signals

three_point_architecture.diagram: Triangle: House 1 (red) ←10G fiber→ House 2 (blue) ←WiFi→ Garage (green) ←WiFi→ House 1

point_1_red.name: House 1 — Brain Side
point_1_red.services: All 17 primals, Gaia Gate :8443, data :8080, Ollama, Tor, Forgejo
point_1_red.connectivity: Wired LAN (MikroTik backbone) + WiFi radios + 10G fiber to House 2

point_2_blue.name: House 2 — South Pole
point_2_blue.compute: blueGate (Gaia IDE, 12 tissue models) + swiftGate (RTX 3070, mobile)
point_2_blue.services: Gaia IDE :3141, tissue inference, mobile demo capability
point_2_blue.connectivity: 10G fiber from House 1 + Flint WiFi + Omada AP

point_3_green.name: Garage — Edge Outpost
point_3_green.services: Lightweight forge mirrors, WiFi extension, edge sensing
point_3_green.connectivity: eero WiFi bridge to existing WiFi signals

eero_wifi_bridge.concept: Eero catches existing WiFi from House 1/2 and provides wired ethernet for garage NUCs

eero_unit.ports: 2× RJ45 (WAN + LAN, or both LAN in bridge mode)
eero_unit.role: WiFi client → connects to Flint/House WiFi, provides ethernet

nuc_1.role: Forge mirror — membrane cascade, heartbeat, ollama-lite

nuc_2.role: Forge mirror — membrane cascade, heartbeat, ollama-lite

topology.step_1: Eero connects to Flint's GAIA WiFi (or ApertureScience) as a WiFi client
topology.step_2: Eero bridges WiFi → ethernet on its 2× RJ45 ports
topology.step_3: NUC-1 and NUC-2 plug into the 2 RJ45 ports
topology.step_4: NUCs get 192.168.4.x addresses from main router DHCP
topology.step_5: NUCs are now on the same flat LAN as all organism nodes
topology.step_6: Optional: second eero extends WiFi further (mesh backhaul)

signal_path.nuc_to_eastgate: NUC → RJ45 → eero → WiFi → Flint/AP → JetStream → 10G fiber → MikroTik → eastGate

power.note: All can run from a single power strip in the garage

garage_coverage.from_house2: Closer to garage — Flint/Omada 5GHz may reach, 2.4GHz definitely
garage_coverage.eero_catches: Best signal wins — eero auto-selects strongest AP
garage_coverage.note: Garage is between/near both houses — good WiFi overlap zone
